platform_cpp_activation: Always enabled for every supported board

compatibility_header_semantics.WCharacter.h: Arduino boolean character helpers backed by the target ctype surface; no Unicode contract
compatibility_header_semantics.binary.h: legacy B0 through B11111111 integer constants
compatibility_header_semantics.WProgram.h: pre-Arduino-1.0 source-compatibility include forwarding to Arduino.h

integration_requirements: Expose the core root as the canonical Arduino public include directory
Only the Clang C++ frontend searches runtime/include; native C uses SDCC headers
Keep Arduino API implementations at the core root and native hardware implementations in hal
Give retained Wiring and hardware declarations extern-C linkage
SPI and Wire own their class headers inside their library src directories
Compile bundled library sources only when selected by the Arduino builder
Synchronize runtime/include and runtime/src from stcxx/sdk/runtime without local edits
Supply native C console hooks from hal/stcxx_console.c; the shared runtime must not depend on Arduino
spi_wire_limits: SPI/Wire select supported hardware routes or retain software master fallback; AI8051U Wire master remains software
STC32G144K246 exposes independent Wire (IIC1) and Wire1 (IIC2) master/slave objects
SPI exposes one controller, or SPI/SPI1/SPI2 on STC32G144K246 with separate state; overlapping transactions across buses are rejected
SPI transactions save/mask/restore registered interrupt enables; this is not a recursive mutex
SPI_CLOCK_DIV2 through SPI_CLOCK_DIV128 are literal divisor ratios and setClockDivider requests F_CPU/divisor; they are not AVR register encodings or a physical-clock guarantee
SPI using/notUsingInterrupt register INT0/INT1 masks or a global interrupt guard; attach/detachInterrupt remain compatibility no-ops because no transfer-completion callback is exposed
SPI usingHardware reports the active backend; G144 hardware requires a verifiable enabled HSIO PLL and otherwise falls back to GPIO
Wire supports 7-bit controller addresses and configurable transmit/receive buffers, default 32 bytes each
Wire implements timeout flags, repeated-start reads, hardware slave begin(address), onReceive and onRequest; 10-bit addressing is not supported

arduino_source_compatibility.hardware_serial_ports: Serial1..4, or Serial1..8 on STC32G144K246; current STC32CL TSSOP20 variants omit unbonded Serial2; 8N1, independent interrupt RX, synchronous TX and checked hardware pin routes

hardware_serial_readBytes.cpp: inherited Stream::readBytes waits until length or the configurable timeout; default 1000 ms

software_serial_cpp.backend: one global active polling port shared by every object; simultaneous multi-instance receive is not provided
software_serial_cpp.receive_servicing: available/peek/read poll automatically; not background reception; default buffer 64 bytes or 16 on low-memory devices
software_serial_cpp.ownership: the last object whose begin or listen succeeds owns the backend; a previous object becomes inactive
software_serial_cpp.inactive_object_behavior: end and destruction do not stop the owner; reads/status/poll are neutral, flush is a no-op, and write fails without entering the HAL
software_serial_cpp.rejected_activation: complete configuration validation occurs before transfer, so a failed begin leaves the existing owner and backend unchanged

arduino_source_compatibility.liquidcrystal_stepper_instances: per-C++-object C HAL state; C API retains its own default state; not ISR/thread-safe objects
arduino_source_compatibility.liquidcrystal_initialization: constructors record pins without using uninitialized Core timers; call begin/init after Core startup; public init rebinds pins and begins 16x1
arduino_source_compatibility.liquidcrystal_row_offsets: per-instance setRowOffsets; begin resets offsets from column count; no busy reads or dual-enable 40x4

sd_cpp.begin_clock_argument: selects the requested data clock after 100 kHz initialization; hardware divider or software fallback
sd_cpp.availableForWrite: INT_MAX for a valid writable file; zero otherwise; not a free-disk-space guarantee
sd_cpp.file_write: FAT16/32 short 8.3 paths, create/append/overwrite/flush/remove, recursive mkdir, empty rmdir, directory iteration and multiple file contexts; no sparse files or power-fail atomicity
sd_cpp.mkdir_remove_rmdir: short-name paths, recursive mkdir, ordinary-file remove, empty-directory rmdir and directory iteration are implemented

network_abstractions.implementation: IPv4/IPv6 IPAddress plus abstract transport interfaces

freestanding_headers.host_behavior: include_next to the host standard library
freestanding_headers.target_behavior: minimal no-exception/no-RTTI declarations and templates for the STC Clang freestanding target

native_libc_boundary.allocator_contract: native malloc/calloc/realloc return values are converted to generic pointers before crossing into C++; MCS251 uses flat 24-bit pointers
native_libc_boundary.string_contract: native wrappers preserve the ISO int API for memset/strchr/strrchr and convert the byte arguments before calling SDCC
native_libc_boundary.stdio_supported: native bounded snprintf; sprintf from SDCC; printf/puts/putchar on initialized UART1; getchar blocks for UART1 input
native_libc_boundary.stdio_limits: installed SDCC format subset only; FILE, scanf, and Clang va_list entry points explicitly unavailable
native_libc_boundary.math_contract: binary32 double APIs bind to native *f symbols; fmodf/roundf/truncf/fminf/fmaxf implemented in Core; no hosted floating exception environment or blanket native libm numeric qualification
native_libc_boundary.integer_format_contract: itoa/utoa/ltoa/ultoa support radix 2..36, unsigned conversion for nondecimal negatives, signed minima without overflow; invalid radix produces an empty string

pgmspace_data_fallback.F_overload_semantics: selects canonical String and Print flash-helper overloads even though the fallback reads the underlying literal as ordinary data
pgmspace_data_fallback.external_flash_helper_values: accepted by String and Print as ordinary data pointers, including third-party f_str-style return values

archive_sidecar_selection.policy: ctor-aware fixed-point selection from direct modules and actual native unresolved C ABI roots; identical anchored linkonce_odr/weak_odr COMDAT functions and globals coalesce exactly once; all other duplicate or ambiguous definitions fail closed
archive_sidecar_selection.manifest_binding: Native stcxx audit.json and manifest.json record the adapted C, optimized IR, final HEX and applicable constructor, alignment, storage and root-symbol audit results

arduino_cli_bridge_adapter.scope: Arduino CLI whole-program LLVM IR and LLVM-CBE fail-closed target adaptation
arduino_cli_bridge_adapter.build_manifest_binding: Native stcxx audit.json and manifest.json record the adapted C, optimized IR, final HEX and applicable constructor, alignment, storage and root-symbol audit results

llvm_itanium_member_function_alignment.policy: Preserve every explicit LLVM align-2 function through LLVM-CBE and SDCC; member-function pointer targets must be a subset; select ASxxxx local parity from final relocation and require every final function address to be even
llvm_itanium_member_function_alignment.build_manifest_binding: Native stcxx audit.json and manifest.json record the adapted C, optimized IR, final HEX and applicable constructor, alignment, storage and root-symbol audit results

arduino_cli_sdcc_warning_audit.scope: Arduino CLI generated C compilation diagnostics after the locked whole-program CBE audit
arduino_cli_sdcc_warning_audit.policy: at most one source-located warning 357 is accepted, only for the exact ArduinoJson 7.4.3 DeserializationError::f_str two-level read-only pgm_read chain; all other source warnings and every ASxxxx address truncation fail closed

arduino_cli_sdcc_gcse_workaround.scope: Arduino CLI LLVM-CBE generated bridge compilation only
arduino_cli_sdcc_gcse_workaround.policy: Disable SDCC 4.6.0 GCSE exactly once for every generated whole-program C++ bridge on MCS251; native C and per-TU placeholder compilation retain normal optimization
arduino_cli_sdcc_gcse_workaround.build_manifest_binding: Native stcxx audit.json and manifest.json record the adapted C, optimized IR, final HEX and applicable constructor, alignment, storage and root-symbol audit results

llvm_cbe_fail_closed_adapter.policy: Only ArduinoJson 7.4.3 V743JB42 AllowAllFilter::operator[] with the exact one-byte integral_constant_OC_10 return definition, two-void-pointer C signature, three StructReturn uses, and an otherwise unused synthetic return alias may be zero-initialized; wrong type/shape/use/function pairings fail closed

runtime: generated constructor bridge described by runtime/runtime-manifest.json
throwing new/new[] failure notifies the OOM hook and then panics if it returns; nothrow failure returns null without invoking either hook

allocator_telemetry.snapshot_result: six packed uint16_t fields: arena, initial total, current total, current largest, minimum total, minimum largest
allocator_telemetry.state_storage: 8 bytes of XDATA in a separate archive member
allocator_telemetry.link_accounting: the heap-provider REL XSEG equals the configured arena; the state REL contributes exactly 8 additional XDATA bytes, defines no heap provider, and is selected exactly once

heap_map_provider_audit.policy: full symbol names are counted exactly in the REL object; only ASlink map display matching uses its fixed 32-character Global column, after proving all audited displays unique

allocator_telemetry.qualification: only allocations routed through the stcxx allocator ABI contribute to the reported low-water marks

api_compatibility.scope: Source and behavior compatibility for the tested portable API; target hardware and ABI limits remain explicit in the platform and library README files
